title: Precision stop · Level 1: Stop at 100 mm
brief: Stop with the front bumper 100 mm from the far wall and stand still for 1 s. Twenty starts, 500 to 900 mm from the wall. The score falls with E = |bias| + 2 x spread; a run that touches the wall, or is not still at 15 s, fails. Par: E = 6 mm.

score.run: if(stopped & touches == 0, round(max(0, 100 - 5 * abs((wall - (endX + bodyFront * cosd(endHeading) + bodyHalf * abs(sind(endHeading)))) - target)), 1), 0)

bias.value: if(stops > 0, sum(r in runs: if(r.stopped & r.touches == 0, (wall - (r.endX + r.bodyFront * cosd(r.endHeading) + r.bodyHalf * abs(sind(r.endHeading)))) - target, 0)) / stops, 0)

spread.value: if(stops > 1, sqrt(sum(r in runs: if(r.stopped & r.touches == 0, ((wall - (r.endX + r.bodyFront * cosd(r.endHeading) + r.bodyHalf * abs(sind(r.endHeading)))) - target - bias) ^ 2, 0)) / (stops - 1)), 0)
